items.title: File NYC Business Corporation Tax return
items.description: C and S corporations doing business in New York City file NYC-2 / NYC-4S (or NYC-3L for general corporations) and pay the tax.

items.title: File NYC Unincorporated Business Tax (UBT) return
items.description: Sole proprietors, partnerships and LLCs taxed as such that carry on a business in New York City file NYC-202 / NYC-204 (4% rate, with credits for some owners).

items.title: Provide NYC Earned Safe and Sick Time
items.authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
items.description: Employers must provide safe and sick leave, post the required notice and give employees written policy.

items.title: Renew San Francisco Business Registration Certificate
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Every business operating in San Francisco must register and renew annually; fee depends on gross receipts.

items.title: File San Francisco gross receipts tax return
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Businesses over the small-business exemption threshold file the annual gross receipts tax return.

items.title: File San Francisco payroll expense tax return
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Payroll expense tax applies to businesses whose San Francisco payroll exceeds the exclusion amount.

items.title: Obtain and renew Los Angeles Business Tax Registration Certificate
items.description: Businesses operating in the City of Los Angeles register for the business tax and renew annually; tax is based on gross receipts and business class.

items.title: Obtain Chicago business license
items.authority: Chicago Department of Business Affairs and Consumer Protection (BACP)
items.description: Most Chicago businesses need a license for their activity and location, with zoning and inspection sign-off where applicable.

items.title: Provide Chicago Paid Leave and Paid Sick and Safe Leave
items.authority: Chicago Department of Business Affairs and Consumer Protection (BACP)
items.description: Employers covered by the Chicago Paid Leave and Paid Sick and Safe Leave Ordinance must provide leave, post notice and keep records.

items.title: Obtain Seattle business license tax certificate and file B&O tax
items.authority: Seattle Department of Finance and Administrative Services
items.description: Seattle requires a business license tax certificate (via the state Business Licensing Service) and a Seattle B&O tax return when taxable revenue exceeds the threshold.

items.title: File Portland and Multnomah County business income taxes
items.description: Businesses with Portland-source income file the City Business License Tax and Multnomah County Business Income Tax through the Revenue Division; Metro supportive housing and Preschool for All taxes apply to higher-income owners.

items.title: Obtain Philadelphia Commercial Activity License
items.description: Free license required for any business operating in Philadelphia; required before other city licenses.

items.title: File Philadelphia Business Income & Receipts Tax (BIRT)
items.description: Annual tax on gross receipts and net income for entities doing business in Philadelphia.

items.title: Withhold and remit Philadelphia Wage Tax
items.description: Employers withhold the city wage tax from employees and remit it with the quarterly reconciliation.

items.title: Obtain Denver sales and use tax license
items.authority: Denver Department of Finance, Treasury Division
items.description: Denver is a home-rule city and administers its own sales and use tax separately from the state.

items.title: Withhold and remit Denver Occupational Privilege Tax (OPT)
items.authority: Denver Department of Finance, Treasury Division
items.description: Employers and employees pay a monthly occupational privilege tax for work performed in Denver.
